name: RecruITIG
title: recruIT FHIR IG
description: FHIR Implementation Guide for the recruIT clinical trial patient recruitment support system.

resource.name: All patients
resource.description: An example of a SQL-encoded eligibility criterion that every patient meets.

resource.name: Clinical study reference
resource.description: A reference to the clinical study that a resource concerns - a List's screened candidates, or a MeasureReport's eligibility attrition funnel

resource.name: Derived from Library
resource.description: A reference to the eligibility-criterion Library resource this assessment - or, on a MeasureReport's attrition-funnel population, this cumulative step - was derived from. Neither Observation.derivedFrom nor MeasureReport.group.population has a slot accepting Library as a target type, so this extension carries the reference instead.

resource.name: EligibilityAssessmentIdentifierSystem
resource.description: The identifier system for a per-criterion eligibility Observation's business identifier. Derived from the ResearchSubject identifier and the Library identifier of the eligibility criterion.

resource.name: EligibilityFunnelMeasureIdentifierSystem
resource.description: The identifier system for a study's attrition-funnel Measure's business identifier - used as the conditional-update key, keyed on the same value as the study's own identifier.

resource.name: EligibilityFunnelReportExample
resource.description: An example of a study's attrition-funnel MeasureReport with a single criterion step.

resource.name: EligibilityFunnelReportIdentifierSystem
resource.description: The identifier system for a study's attrition-funnel MeasureReport's business identifier - used as the conditional-update key, keyed on the same value as the study's own identifier.

resource.name: EligibilityGroup
resource.description: A profile for the Group resource referenced by a RecruitResearchStudy's enrollment, which defines the study's eligibility criteria as characteristics referencing one or more SQLQueryLibrary criteria.

resource.name: EligibilityGroupExample
resource.description: An example of a recruIT eligibility Group with a single inclusion criterion.

resource.name: EligibilityGroupIdentifierSystem
resource.description: The identifier system for the Group containing references to one or more eligibility criteria Library resources

resource.name: EligibilityLibraryIdentifierSystem
resource.description: The identifier system for a criterion expressed in a Library resource

resource.name: EXAMPLE eligibility attrition funnel
resource.description: An example of a study's attrition-funnel Measure.

resource.name: GroupCharacteristicReference
resource.description: An entity referenced in a characteristic

resource.name: ObservationDerivedFromLibrary
resource.description: The Library resource containing the eligibility criterion this Observation was derived from

resource.name: recruIT eligibility assessment
resource.description: A per-criterion eligibility Assessment produced by the query engine, indicating whether a single eligibility criterion is met for a ResearchSubject.

resource.name: recruIT eligibility assessment category
resource.description: A custom, non-standard Observation.category code identifying the per-criterion eligibility Assessments produced by the query eligibility engine..

resource.name: recruIT eligibility assessment result
resource.description: The SNOMED CT qualifier values a per-criterion eligibility assessment's value may be set to, indicating whether the criterion is met, not met, unknown, or indeterminate.

resource.name: recruIT eligibility criteria type
resource.description: How an eligibility Group's criteria are encoded. Purely descriptive - query-sql-on-fhir discovers studies by their criteria Libraries' type, not by this code.

resource.name: recruIT eligibility criteria types
resource.description: The ways an eligibility Group's criteria may be encoded.

resource.name: recruIT eligibility funnel Measure
resource.description: The Measure a study's attrition-funnel MeasureReport is reported against. Nothing is evaluated as a quality measure - it exists so MeasureReport.measure has a real canonical to resolve, and lists the criterion Libraries the funnel steps were derived from.

resource.name: recruIT eligibility funnel MeasureReport
resource.description: A study's eligibility attrition funnel: the total screened population, followed by one population per eligibility criterion holding the number of patients remaining after cumulatively applying it, in Group.characteristic order.

resource.name: recruIT eligibility funnel population type
resource.description: The two population kinds making up a study's attrition-funnel MeasureReport.group.population: the total screened population, and the population remaining after cumulatively applying one more criterion.

resource.name: recruIT eligibility funnel population types
resource.description: The population kinds a study's attrition-funnel MeasureReport.group.population may be coded as.

resource.name: RecruitResearchStudy
resource.description: A profile for the ResearchStudy resource used to represent a clinical trial, based on the MII Studie module's ResearchStudy profile.

resource.name: RecruitResearchStudyExample
resource.description: An example of a recruIT ResearchStudy.

resource.name: RecruitSampleStudyTransaction
resource.description: A demo ResearchStudy with three SQL-encoded eligibility criteria, each in both the Trino and the DuckDB dialect: a bronchitis diagnosis, an age over 18, and no sepsis diagnosis within 3 months of the bronchitis diagnosis.

resource.name: ResearchStudyEnrollment
resource.description: The Group resource representing the study enrollment

resource.name: ResearchSubjectIdentifierSystem
resource.description: The identifier system for a recruIT-created ResearchSubject's business identifier

resource.name: ScreeningList
resource.description: A profile for the List resource used to represent a list of identified study candidates.

resource.name: ScreeningListIdentifierSystem
resource.description: The identifier system for a screening List's business identifier, which is the study's own identifier - used as the conditional-update key for a study's screening List.

resource.name: SearchParameterBelongsToStudy
resource.description: The ResearchStudy a List or MeasureReport pertains to

resource.name: SQL Query Library
resource.description: A Library holding a SQL-encoded eligibility criterion, one content per supported SQL dialect. Mirrors the SQL on FHIR SQLQuery profile.

resource.name: SqlCriteriaLibraryIdentifierSystem
resource.description: The identifier system for a SQLQueryLibrary criterion authored as FSH, such as the demo study's criteria.

resource.name: SqlCriteriaResearchStudyIdentifierSystem
resource.description: The identifier system for a RecruitResearchStudy whose SQL-encoded criteria are authored as FSH, such as the demo study.

resource.name: SupersetSyncedEligibilityLibraryIdentifierSystem
resource.description: The identifier system for a criterion expressed in a Library resource when synced from a Superset instance.

resource.name: Test
resource.description: An example of a screening list.

resource.name: UICreatedEligibilityLibraryIdentifierSystem
resource.description: The identifier system for a criterion expressed in a Library resource created via the UI.

resource.name: UICreatedResearchStudyIdentifierSystem
resource.description: The identifier system for a ResearchStudy resource created via the UI.
